messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: elevated 5xx spike from edge -> gateway for several customers. First alert at 4520009950. Error type: 502/504 + connection timeouts. Impacting US-west and EU-region traffic. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/4520009999
zoe: I’m on it. Seeing spike from our ingress logs, explosion of 502 from backend pool `canary-ml-v2`. Aggregate 5xx went from 0.3% -> 12% in 2m.
mike: I can confirm dashboards — per-route error heatmap points to path split rule `/api/v1/generate` with header: `X-Canary: true`. Traffic was supposed to be 5% but metric shows 42%.
ali: Who pushed the ingress route split? last change looks like PR 4782 merged ~4520009800 by infra/ingress-team.
sam: I’m tailing envoy logs on a few frontends. Seeing repeated `upstream reset` and `503 no healthy upstream` for cluster `backend-canary-ml-v2`. Full log sample:
```
[INGRESS] envoy error: "upstream connection failure" cluster=backend-canary-ml-v2, downstream_remote_address=10.8.2.44:50212
[PROXY] 502 response from 10.9.10.23: upstream reset
```
zoe: Healthcheck flapping on the canary hosts — they’re returning 503 on readiness probes intermittently. Possible memory pressure from model container.
beth: Paging app-owner to confirm canary health — @ingress-eng-bot please notify #eng-ml and #platform-owners.
ingress-eng-bot: Notified @eng-ml, @platform-owners, and created INCIDENT-4520009999 in PagerDuty.
ali: Mitigation options: 1) remove header-based split so traffic stops going to canary, 2) set route weight to 0 for canary, 3) mark cluster as unhealthy in LB to drain.
mike: Quickest is weight -> 0. I can update route weight in envoy config now. Doing `rbac`-safe rollback via control plane.
sam: If we flip weight we should also disable retries on the problematic route to avoid retry storms. Current route has `retry_policy: 3xx,5xx`.
zoe: Agree. Doing steps: 1) set canary weight 0, 2) disable retries on path `/api/v1/generate`, 3) ramp up capacity on stable pool. Running commands now.
zoe: Applying config patch:
```
# control-plane patch
patch route generate-path {
  weight: canary -> 0
  retry_policy: disabled
}
```
mike: Patch deployed to 3 control plane instances, pushing to frontends.
sam: Observing slow decrease in 5xx rate. Dashboards: 12% -> 4% within 30s.
beth: Customer impact: Support ticket influx from two enterprise customers, SLA risk reported. Logging a customer impact note in incident doc.
ali: Can we also temporarily increase circuit breaker thresholds for the downstream cluster so Envoy won’t trip early and cascade? That might be risky but reduces 5xx.
zoe: I’m wary of increasing CB now — it could hide real failures. Prefer draining canary and leave CB as is.
mike: Agreed with Zoe. Keep CB as-is until canary is out of rotation. If we still see cascading, then revisit.
ingress-eng-bot: Automatic rollback trigger watching: if 5xx > 5% for 10m, will alert. Current 5xx at 2.1%.
sam: Backend owners: do you want us to kill canary pod group in k8s or leave them to recover? Killing would stop flapping quickly.
eng-ml (automated message): Canaries report OOMs on model-worker due to batch size misconfig on v2. Patch incoming from eng-ml PR 4790.
ali: Let's coordinate — if eng-ml can merge and rollout a fix, we can leave pods and let them become healthy. If not, kill and redeploy stable image.
beth: I notified account execs for affected customers and set expectations: mitigation in progress, potential brief errors while we stabilize.
zoe: Canary weight set to 0 and retries disabled — change visible in envoy: `/routes` shows active weight=0. Confirmed via `curl` test to frontend returns 200 from stable pool.
mike: Rolling window 1m 5xx dropped to 0.8%. Good. I’ll keep monitoring for 30m and then request incident de-escalation if stable.
sam: Also added temporary rule to strip `X-Canary` header from external traffic at edge to be safe.
zoe: Adding note: root cause looks like a bad model config causing memory pressure under realistic traffic; ingress split amplified failure surface and retries made it worse. Recommendation: no header-based GA splits without canary autoscaling + health stabilization.
ali: Filing follow-up action items: 1) revert header-split feature flag until autoscaler is certified, 2) add canary health panic detection to control plane, 3) add safer default retry config for path-based model endpoints.
beth: Logged follow-up items in INCIDENT-4520009999-POSTMORTEM. Tentative P1 postmortem owner: @zoe.
ingress-eng-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Paging cleared. Final notes: total incident duration ~ 34m, peak 5xx 12%, affected regions US-west & EU, customers with increased error rate: acct-1123, acct-9987.
zoe: Thanks all. Handing back to oncall rotation. If anything regresses ping this thread.
oncall-rotation: Acknowledged, will monitor for next 2 hours and run postmortem writeup with eng-ml.

(reactions: :thumbsup: to Zoe/Mike/Sam; :eyes: from eng-lead)
